company_overview.from_documents: The supplied profiles present an engineering, civil-construction, fabrication and industrial-services company that supplies labour, welds and fabricates, erects steel structures, installs plant/machines and pipework, lags/insulates, maintains and commissions plant, and (in the 2025 Uganda profile) executes civil foundations, warehouses and factory buildings. It is not documented as a retail hardware shop.
